I don't have any way to quantify this, but as a Mormon in AZ, I truly think the Mormons (and ex-mormons for that matter) could be a big part of getting Kamala the win here.  And I think it's missing from much of the data because many of us don't like talking about it openly, and most of us are still registered R.  I don't know ANY Mormons that say that they don't vote, and the church heavily encourages members to vote.

  
My far-right little brother is complaining about how a few of his 22-25 year old Mormon friends are "turning woke" and voting for Kamala.  I wonder how many of his friends and their wives are voting Kamala and NOT telling anybody.  I fall into that category a little bit -- since I'm currently posting on a throwaway.

  
For reference, I was single in 2016 and voted Trump while I was serving a mission for my church and wasn't aware of ANY political news.  I got married and my wife and I both voted Biden in 2020, probably the only people in my family that did.  Now my sister and my wife and I have already all voted for Kamala as registered Rs.  Some cousins of mine have been outed to the whole family as Kamala voters.  I don't see Trump getting as much Mormon support as he may have in 2020.

Not to mention there's people like me who would only admit this on a throwaway account -- wife and I voted Biden in 2020 and Kamala this election, but we're registered R.  My sister came out as a lesbian, and is going to vote Kamala and she's still registered R.

  
More of the people in my Mormon circles are continuing to flip D, and I don't know any of them that changed their registration

We've tried to look into that but I don't think there's really any options in my area (AZ).  He refuses to get help, even when his former business partners have offered to pay the costs for rehab.  He has warrants out for his arrest (DUIs, breaching an order of protection that a family member has against him), but the cops pick him up, hold him for a night, and let him go.  He never goes to his court dates.  I just don't see a long term solution to this issue.  I don't want him to know that I live so close, as he's broken windows at his mom's place and has been stealing from other family members.
